title: Microneedling
caption: Microneedling uses a device covered in fine needles to create thousands of tiny, controlled punctures in the skin's surface. Those micro-injuries trigger your skin's own repair process — collagen and elastin production ramps up as the skin closes each channel. The treatment doesn't add anything from outside; it borrows from your body's existing healing system. That distinction tells you what results are actually driven by — your biology, on its own timeline. Not medical advice, just the honest basics. Learn more at cliniclick.ae
